Cash Consideration: $27.00 per Company Common Share; Stock Consideration: a number of Parent Common Shares equal to the Exchange Ratio per share; Cash in lieu of fractional shares as specified in Section 2.07; The Merger Consideration is the combination of Cash Consideration and the stock equal to the Exchange Ratio.
The Exchange Ratio is tiered by the Parent Stock Price: if the Parent Stock Price is equal to or less than $67.50, 0.4000; if the Parent Stock Price is greater than $67.50 but less than $112.50, the quotient obtained by dividing $27.00 by the Parent Stock Price, rounded to four decimal places; or if the Parent Stock Price is greater than or equal to $112.50, 0.2400. Each Company Common Share outstanding immediately prior to the First Effective Time will automatically be converted into the right to receive (A) $27.00 in cash (the"Cash Consideration") and (B) a number of Parent Common Shares equal to the Exchange Ratio.
